newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 2.53 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 2.53 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Dewan Salman Fibre rose 0.90 rupees, or 2.53 percent to 35.65 on Thursday on expectations of good results for the six months to December 31, dealers said.
Some 824,000 shares of Dewan Salman had changed hands at Karachi bourse by midsession.
Dealer Ali Asghar said Dewan Salman's performance had remained good this year and it was expected to report healthy results, in line with the rest of the synthetic sector.
"Dewan Salman earnings are expected to increase sharply this year as the government has brought favourable changes in the tariff structure and had given duty concessions," he said.
